canonical_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme, Madhya Pradesh

names_local.hi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना, मध्य प्रदेश

disambiguation: Implementation in Madhya Pradesh. Every figure held here is State-level, never national.

coverage.note: Holds only what one document records: the Comptroller and Auditor General's performance audit of MGNREGA in Madhya Pradesh for 2019-24, which reports State-level expenditure by financial year. Nothing is held about the scheme in any other State, about any period outside 2019-24, or about individual works, workers or households. An empty period means no record is held here, not that nothing happened.
